name: opencode-analyze-image
description: OpenCode plugin that lets text-only models analyze image attachments, URLs, files, and directories through an auxiliary vision model.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test && python3 -m unittest discover -s python/tests -p 'test_*.py'
